dataset.recording_source: Generated locally by backend_04h_benchmark.py and run_minimum_inference.write_fixture.
dataset.license_status: Original synthetic signal created for this local research run. No scraped audio and no external download. Not a musical performance.
dataset.ground_truth: Synthesizer schedule. Chord labels and click times were produced by this script, not by an independent annotator.

repository_search.note: Tracked wav, mp3, flac, and ogg assets are absent. chord_placeholder.lab is empty. External datasets named in third-party READMEs were not downloaded.

duration_selection.reason: A 120-second or 180-second 22050 Hz 16-bit mono WAV exceeds TestingConfig DIRECT_UPLOAD_SIZE_LIMIT_MB=5. The cap was not raised.

ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 6.1.1-3ubuntu5 Copyright (c) 2000-2023 the FFmpeg developers

reference_wav.provenance: Existing 12-second synthetic WAV from run_minimum_inference.write_fixture. No external recording.
reference_wav.license: Original synthetic signal. No third-party recording.

long_wav.provenance: Synthetic 96-second PCM generated in backend_04h_benchmark.py. Four-second C:maj/F:maj/G:maj cycle and a click every 0.5 seconds. Not a performance.
long_wav.license: Original synthetic signal. No third-party recording.

long_mp3.provenance: LAME MPEG Layer III encoded from the 96-second synthetic WAV with ffmpeg libmp3lame 128k. Encoder ID3 was removed. Not a performance.
long_mp3.license: Original synthetic signal. No third-party recording.

synthetic_quality.vocabulary: Exact Chord-CNN-LSTM submission strings. The generator uses C:maj, F:maj, and G:maj. N is the model's no-chord label. No enharmonic folding, no inversion folding, and no major/minor equivalence. A slice counts as correct only when the strings are equal.
synthetic_quality.beat_metric: One-to-one greedy match inside a 70 ms window. Click spacing is 500 ms, so the windows do not overlap. This is not the mir_eval package.
synthetic_quality.tempo_change_reason: The click interval is constant. No tempo change was synthesized.
synthetic_quality.confidence_note: confidence 1.0 is the lab parser placeholder, not a measured model score.
